svg.title: The Fix Toolkit
svg.desc: A pegboard with eight panels holding thirteen tools. Accessibility panel, blue: AI alt text generation, caption generation, heading repair. Readability panel, blue: reading level rewrite, glossary generation. Accuracy and currency panel, blue: link repair, content update. Practice with feedback panel, blue: practice question generation, MicroSim building. Metadata panel, purple: metadata generation. Open license panel, purple: license statement repair. Modularity panel, purple: chapter splitting. Editable source panel, purple: PDF-to-Markdown conversion. Every tool has a small person-with-check badge for the human check.
